Trading-day/holiday/early-close calendar support versus clock-reference-only labeling

Implement pure timezone-aware context function in the existing feature module with synthetic boundary/DST tests
Wire only to a separately versioned future schema; preserve the closed V1.2.3 dataset and existing frozen contract
Reconcile schema/collector compatibility and create separate new dataset paths before collection

limitations: This is a plan, not an implemented feature, frozen session definition, new hypothesis confirmation, or justification for post-hoc subgroup analysis.
